title: AI Kit: organization settings (organization.json)
description: What the organization decides, in the kit repository. Changed by merge request; each workstation then runs update.

allowed_domains.description: Expected email domains; doctor warns when a CLI is signed in with another account (a personal one, for example). Empty: no check.

defaults.description: Organization defaults, same keys as overrides.json; each person's overrides.json is applied on top.
